A phone's diff file picker follows the ranked order, and a highlight comment uses the comment rail. Use condition waits, never sleep steps. Use the supplied selectors directly. The conversation at /c/{{SLUG}} works in a git repo whose top commit, "Highlighted commit", changes src/zeta.ts (line 160 becomes "const critical = true;"), README.md and src/alpha.ts, and carries commit highlights that rank the files zeta.ts, README.md, alpha.ts and comment on src/zeta.ts line 160 ("The one line that matters.") and README.md line 3 ("Docs follow the code."). "The overlay" is the ".diff-viewer-overlay" element; "the files" are the overlay's ".diff-tree-row[aria-selected]" elements, in document order; "the second file" is the one at index 1 (pick it with "nth": 1, scoped with "within" the overlay). Perform the steps in order.
1. Navigate to /c/{{SLUG}} and wait for the message input ([data-testid="message-input"]) to be visible (allow 30s).
2. Open the Diffs workspace tool: wait for the ".header" element to be visible, then click the button with accessible name exactly "Diffs" inside ".chat-workspace-actions" (when that toolbar is not shown, click the button named exactly "More options" and then the button whose name starts with "Diffs" in ".chat-overflow-popover"). The overlay becomes visible (allow 30s).
3. Click the first ".diff-rethink-message-files .diff-tree-code-row" in the overlay, then click ".diff-rethink-file-jump" to open the file picker.
4. Assert the texts of ".diff-rethink-mobile-files .diff-tree-code-row[aria-selected] .diff-tree-label" are exactly "zeta.ts", "README.md", "alpha.ts", in order (the rows include extra icons and counts; check only their .diff-tree-label children). Click the first row; ".diff-rethink-file-name" reads "zeta.ts", and ".diff-rethink-file-position" contains "File 1 of 3".
5. The narrow diff is inline; the comment still shows under its line: "the callout" is the overlay's ".diff-highlight-callout-text": it has exactly the text "The one line that matters." and is in the viewport.
6. A tap on the callout's button opens the comment rail, though Monaco claims touches inside the editor: tap (touch start, then touch end) the button with role "button" and name exactly "Comment" inside the overlay's element with role "note". The ".diff-rethink-rail-input" is visible, focused, and has aria-label "Comment on Line 160, new". There is no ".diff-viewer-comment-dialog" or ".diff-viewer-selected-text".
7. Fill ".diff-rethink-rail-input" with "Why this line?" and click ".diff-rethink-change-nav .diff-rethink-comment-change" (Save Comment). The rail input closes and the "Comment on current hunk" button returns.
8. The message input ([data-testid="message-input"]) is still empty. Click ".diff-rethink-change-nav .diff-draft-review-toggle" (the visible mobile rail's review button, not the hidden desktop duplicate). The open ".diff-draft-review[open]" has exactly one article containing "src/zeta.ts:160 (new)" and "Why this line?". Expand its Quote details. Its pre text is exactly "const critical = true;\n★ The one line that matters.".
9. Click "Send to Chat". The review and diff close. One ".message-user" contains "src/zeta.ts:160 (new)", "> const critical = true;", "> ★ The one line that matters.", and "Why this line?". The composer is still empty.
